name: Spectrum TG45SC-E Petrol Scarifier & Aerator - 223cc, 45cm, Electric Key Start
Body Copy: Strip moss and thatch in spring, then open compacted soil in autumn, all from one machine. The Spectrum TG45SC-E arrives with a 45cm scarifier cassette fitted and an aerator cassette in the box, so you change jobs by hand without reaching for tools. A 223cc 4-stroke petrol engine drives 18 blades through dense thatch on lawns up to 2,000m². Electric key start turns the engine over on demand, with a recoil starter kept as backup for a flat battery. Six working heights from -12mm to +10mm let you match the pass to each lawn, while a blade-engage clutch lets you empty the 45-litre collector without shutting the engine down. A pressed steel deck holds the blade shafts true under load, where lighter decks flex.
Unique Selling Point 01: Electric key start fires the engine on demand, with recoil backup
Unique Selling Point 02: Scarifier and aerator cassettes both supplied for year-round lawn care
Unique Selling Point 03: 223cc 4-stroke petrol engine drives 18 blades through heavy thatch
Unique Selling Point 04: 45cm working width covers lawns up to 2,000m²
Unique Selling Point 05: Six working heights from -12mm to +10mm set by one lever
Unique Selling Point 06: Blade-engage clutch empties the collector without stopping the engine
Unique Selling Point 07: Pressed steel deck keeps the blade shafts aligned under load
Unique Selling Point 08: 45-litre collector runs open for clearing bulk thatch
Selling Copy: Two machines in one: a 45cm scarifier that clears moss and thatch, and an aerator cassette that relieves compacted soil, both supplied as standard. Electric key start takes the strain out of cold mornings, while the 223cc petrol engine and pressed steel deck see off lawns up to 2,000m² season after season.
